sources: Wizards Mystery Booster Commander Edition Release Notes — The Madcap Jester and Dragon’s Smile card text/rulings
Magic Comprehensive Rules — replacement effects, triggered abilities, casting from exile, face-down exile, alternative costs, Oracle win conditions
Current Oracle text in current-cycle Scryfall cache

interactions.name: Madcap attack and access triggers
interactions.finding: When The Madcap Jester attacks, its first triggered ability causes each opponent to exile the top card of their library. That controlled ability satisfies the second trigger condition; cards covered by the resulting permission may be played until the end of your next turn, subject to normal timing and costs, with mana of any type allowed.

interactions.name: Ashiok Nightmare Weaver
interactions.finding: Ashiok’s +2 exiles the top three cards of target opponent’s library. With Jester under your control, that planeswalker ability is a direct qualifying library-exile source and the exiled cards receive Jester play permission.

interactions.name: Direct exile suite
interactions.finding: Extract, Sadistic Sacrament, Bitter Ordeal, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter, Inside Information, Jester’s Cap, Psychic Surgery and other retained controlled effects that exile cards directly from opponent libraries qualify for Jester when their instructions produce the exile event.

interactions.name: Dauthi replacement plus controlled mill
interactions.finding: Dauthi Voidwalker replaces an event that would put an opponent-owned card into that opponent’s graveyard with exile instead. Under CR 614.6 the original event does not occur and the modified exile event occurs and may trigger abilities. When the replaced movement was being caused by a spell or ability you control and the card moved from an opponent’s library, the modified event satisfies Jester; Dauthi does not by itself make unrelated opponent-caused mill qualify.

interactions.name: Brain Freeze with Dauthi
interactions.finding: Brain Freeze targeting an opponent while Dauthi is present has its library-to-graveyard movement replaced with exile, producing qualifying Jester access. Brain Freeze targeting yourself is unaffected because Dauthi applies only to cards owned by opponents, preserving the Breach self-mill line.

interactions.name: Jesters Scepter face-down exile
interactions.finding: Jester’s Scepter exiles the top five cards of a target player’s library face down and expressly allows its controller to look at them. Current casting rules permit beginning to cast a face-down exiled spell card when the player is allowed to look at it; Jester supplies the separate play permission while normal timing/cost restrictions still apply.

interactions.name: Lightning Greaves
interactions.finding: Haste from Lightning Greaves lets a newly controlled Jester attack immediately. Shroud does not stop either Jester triggered ability because neither targets Jester.

interactions.name: Thassa Oracle plus Demonic Consultation
interactions.finding: With Thassa’s Oracle trigger on the stack, Demonic Consultation may name a card absent from the library and exile the library; Oracle then checks devotion against cards remaining and can win the game.

interactions.name: Thassa Oracle plus Tainted Pact
interactions.finding: The candidate has 100 distinct card names. With Oracle’s trigger pending, Tainted Pact can decline every revealed card without encountering two cards of the same name, allowing the library to be exiled before Oracle resolves.

interactions.name: Underworld Breach LED Brain Freeze
interactions.finding: Underworld Breach, Lion’s Eye Diamond and Brain Freeze retain the standard recursive storm/self-mill finish when sufficient graveyard resources are available; Dauthi Voidwalker does not replace cards from your own library or graveyard.

interactions.name: Dragon’s Smile alternative cost
interactions.finding: Dragon’s Smile may provide a zero alternative mana cost once each of your turns for a spell cast from exile, including an opponent-owned spell Jester permits you to cast. Other alternative costs cannot also be used, while applicable additional costs may still be paid.

interactions.name: Cast-from-exile payoffs
interactions.finding: Passionate Archaeologist, Nalfeshnee, Prosper and Wild-Magic Sorcerer all see spells actually cast from exile under Jester permission and apply their respective damage, copy, Treasure or cascade payoffs subject to each card’s own trigger restrictions.

interactions.name: Future-release project exceptions
interactions.finding: The Madcap Jester and Dragon’s Smile are preserved only under the registered project future-release exceptions on 2026-10-15. Wizards states new-to-Magic MBC cards become Commander-legal on 2026-11-13; no claim of present official legality is made.
